name: Cheque Book Validation
script:
# --------------------------------------------------
# Cheque Book Validation
# Trigger: Before Save
# --------------------------------------------------

if doc.doctype == "Cheque Book":

    # Convert values safely
    try:
        start = int(doc.first_leaf_no)
        end = int(doc.last_leaf_no)
    except:
        raise Exception("Cheque numbers must be numeric.")

    # --------------------------------------------------
    # 1️⃣ Validate Range Order
    # --------------------------------------------------
    if end <= start:
        raise Exception("Last Leaf Number must be greater than First Leaf Number.")

    # --------------------------------------------------
    # 2️⃣ Validate Max Range (< 50)
    # --------------------------------------------------
    difference = end - start

    if difference >= 50:
        raise Exception("Cheque book range cannot exceed 50 leaves.")

    # --------------------------------------------------
    # 3️⃣ Auto Calculate No of Leaves
    # --------------------------------------------------
    doc.no_of_leaves = difference + 1

name: Payment Entry Security Cheque Validation
